text:
Marco: Heads-up — onboarding OrpheusX-lite variant. After conversion to our canonical tokenizer, we see a repeated embed-proj shift that only shows up when running with Gemma and Qwen-style rotary interop. Details below.
Lena: Can you repro locally or only on CI?
Marco: Repro locally with a short prompt. Noticed mismatch in KV alignment after first 2 tokens; outputs diverge after step 6. :thinking_face:
Sahil: Any diffs in tokenizer.json or vocab ordering? Those usually bite us.
Marco: Vocab diff is subtle — pad/sentinel index moved from 1 -> 2 during conversion script. Also our rotary index mapping uses head-offset assumed pad=1. If pad changes, kvcache tokenids shift and rotary phase gets misapplied.
Amelia: Oof. Do you have a repro snippet?
Marco: Pasted small test run:
```
# run minimal prompt
prompt = "Hello"
model = "orpheusx-lite"
out_host = run_inference(prompt)
# compare kvcache dumps
compare_kv(out_host, out_ref)
```
Lena: Patch idea: add an explicit pad_remap stage in convert_tokenizer that normalizes pad/sentinel to 1 for models that don't follow our convention.
Sahil: Also add a check in rope mapper: assert vocab[pad_token]==1 else warn and remap. Saves headwise rotation misaligns.
Marco: Tried remap — fixes Gemma+Qwen combo. But with int4 quant we still see small rotary angle drift causing long-context dampening.
Amelia: Might be quant kernel rounding. Run fp16 baseline then int4 quant with and without rotary scaling float-rescale.
Marco: Results: fp16 matches expected; int4 leads to 0.8% perplexity regression on lm-bench and periodic hallucination on longctx. Suspect combined effect of quantized matmul + rotary scaling rounding.
Sahil: Quick mitigation: enable per-head rotary rescale (scale=0.999 -> reduce drift) and fallback to a slightly less aggressive quant scheme for heads with high freq.
Amelia: Filed a small eval PR with experimental configs. If teams want to onboard OrpheusX, recommend conversion patch + disable extreme int4 until we get kernel fixes. :+1:
deploy-bot: CI job orpheusx-conversion-smoke failed on longctx test — see https://ci.redwood/1234
Marco: Thx — I'll attach kv dumps and tokenizer diffs to the PR.
Lena: Nice triage. Can we add a short lint in model-onboard checklist so future conversions check pad/sentinel index and rotary handshake?
Sahil: Yes — I'll add a checklist item and a small unit test for kvcache token alignment.
Amelia: If we need help with kernel folks, loop in @ingrid from infra-kernels.
Marco: Will do. Thanks everyone :eyes:
